compatibilityNotes: 512x128 facade atlas: five buildings in day/night rows; 32x96 lighthouse day/night at x416/x448 side by side because two 96px rows cannot fit 128px height.
64 populated tiles per theme; remaining 192 cells transparent. Identical cell semantics in both tides.
16 corner-Wang water tiles provide cardinal and diagonal boundaries; use shared corner vertices, not NESW edge masks.
Facade pieces require region registration in a later integration; no runtime bindings changed.
